query: What does VoyageFlow say about verifying travel information before booking?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow strongly encourages users to verify several details before finalizing any booking [booking-policies::003]. This includes the current price on the partner platform, as VoyageFlow does not display live prices [booking-policies::003]. Users should also verify the cancellation policy and refund window [booking-policies::003], as well as the room type, bed configuration, and included amenities [booking-policies::003]. The total cost, including taxes, fees, and resort charges, should also be confirmed [booking-policies::003]. Furthermore, VoyageFlow recommends verifying passport validity and visa requirements for the destination [booking-policies::003], along with local health advisories and travel warnings [voyageflow-overview::004]. Users are responsible for confirming all details before payment [voyageflow-overview::004].
